semantics.definition: The rule Button and Chip share for an address: inside No Origins (a path, a part of the page, or a name of No Origins) or outside it (any other site, or another kind of address). The address is read the way a browser reads it, so what is said is where the link really goes.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one place that says where an address leads, so every link of No Origins draws the same sign for the same address. It changes only through a proposal you approve.

spec.job: Say whether an address is inside No Origins or leads to another site.
